name: Saksoft Ltd
title: Saksoft Ltd - 590051 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue ~INR 249 cr, up 4% YoY and down 0.8% QoQ; management targets 30% growth but expects only 14-15%, with pipeline USD 25 mn (vs USD 5 mn six months ago) and decisions still deferred.

utilisation.quote: the utilization level of employees, excluding trainees being at 83% for the full Financial Year

triggers.label: Pipeline USD 5 mn → USD 25 mn
triggers.quote: the pipeline that we have today is in the region of USD 25 million. It's the highest we have ever had.

triggers.label: Renewals to be repriced lower for AI
triggers.quote: customers are expecting at renewal time contracts to be revised at a lower price because of the AI productivity that AI warrants.
triggers.highlight: contracts to be revised at a lower price

triggers.label: Headcount de-grown; technical staff down ~4.5%
triggers.quote: technical employees are down roughly 4.5% this year

triggers.label: Growth target 30%, realistic 14-15%
triggers.quote: I'll put my money more on that than on the 30%.
triggers.highlight: I'll put my money more on that

guidance.quote: We are aiming for 30%. We should be able to get at 15%, even assuming that the rupee appreciates a little bit.
There might be a little bit of a dip, Bharat, because of 2 reasons.
85%, Bharat is probably the highest number that we can probably aim for.

red_flags.label: Revenue concentration: top 10 clients ~58%
red_flags.quote: our 58% of revenue is coming from 10 clients only

red_flags.label: Renewal repricing and AI cannibalisation
red_flags.quote: customers are expecting at renewal time contracts to be revised at a lower price

evasions.quote: I really wish I could give you a concrete answer.
